name: evoarena-frozen-v2
goal: Evolve a shared skill on training tasks, then freeze it on held-out repositories
selection: One longest original complete chain per repository; require full unique-task coverage
rationale: Use fully cached repositories because local storage cannot accommodate the remaining environments.
Increase training from four repositories/40 tasks to six repositories/70 tasks, adding Go DNS and logging experience.
Keep four separate repositories/45 tasks for frozen evaluation, covering Go and Python.
Hold whole repositories together; preserve original complete chains and grading metadata.
Do not run the two cached nats tasks as a truncated chain or mix its other tasks into test.
Training prefixes end on chain boundaries; report all chosen checkpoints on the same test set rather than choosing the best from test scores.
This resource-constrained pilot split does not replace the original full dataset or demonstrate broad multilingual generalization.
